market_summary: Strong bearish trend expansion in XAUUSD breaking session lows with CVD alignment and volume expansion. FX majors (EURUSD, GBPUSD) consolidating inside value areas near session lows without volume momentum. US100 and BTCUSD remain structurally bullish above VAH and VWAP but are extended near session highs with fading momentum, making XAUUSD the primary high-confluence directional move.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4028.41) and below POC (4043.91). CVD is -2.79 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-0.37), confirming continuous selling pressure in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below VWAP (4036.90) and EMA50 (4028.47), pushing past the lower ATR band (3999.58) after breaking the Session Low (3992.99) with strong momentum. Recent yellow RVOL spikes confirm violent directional breakdown.

Price is above VAH (28337.86) and well above POC (28264.82). CVD is +12.62 (BULLISH) despite mild short-term pullback slope (-0.62) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well above VWAP (28185.47) and EMA50 (28266.62), testing near the upper ATR band (28521.60) and just below Session High (28565.11). Volume is steady (US100 CFD tick volume caveat applies). Price is extended near session extremes, making fresh entry sub-optimal without a pullback.
